status: Provisional hypotheses for independent refutation, not findings.

candidates.claim: Non-pipe response content is silently discarded; qualifiers can vanish and later note line numbers attach the wrong fact.
KB import/restore silently truncates text/quotes and drops conditions/facts above caps.
Numeric tokenization drops Unicode minus and unit exponents; can also warn falsely for equivalent ASCII/Unicode negative forms.
Numeric hints are not checked because only revealed text enters scanner. Determine defect versus explicit narrow advisory scope.
A later nested malformed primary extraction conditions:[null] prevents committing earlier successful chunks, unlike normal API error.
Wrong-shaped omission response becomes +0 recovered rather than inconclusive.
A model-controlled first-pass pointer names a never-read file/page and reaches Anki source export.
No quotes attempted still displays green Every first-pass quote was located text. Missing-anchor validator warnings exist; assess overstatement.
Nonempty STOP non-card prose commits successful zero-note generation rather than malformed response status.
Deduplication precedes alias normalization; two alias/canonical variants become byte-identical selected export rows.
Arbitrary Text edits retain fact IDs and all-tier linked association count. Is the documented association count misrepresenting semantic coverage?
Invalid tier/bucket silently become Tier3/Look including safetyCritical import, with dropped0 and no validator issue.
Partial parsable MAX_TOKENS output retained with explicit warning/truncated flag but final green Complete log.
Invalid duplicates are exempt from dedupe and remain identical after manual repair. Determine whether automatic deletion is justified.
Import/build rekeys fact IDs; determine actual same-session stale association against source replacement guards and captured snapshots.
Quote operator mismatch only warns and fact/quote entailment is not checked. Deliberate policy versus bug.
Header exporter escapes only &<> in Text/Extra, not quotes/Tags. Demonstrate actual data loss or classify native Anki gap.
kbBuildSourceChunks catches quality/probe exceptions silently. Need reachable ordinary-input failure rather than injected throwing helper only.
Receipt/recall leaf returns [] on missing evidence. Public decoder rejects invalid receipts and mapping status stays inconclusive; determine actual approval.
Source false fact with true quote becomes faithful KB->card->export. Source-boundary limitation rather than deterministic semantic checker bug.
Unsupported model suggestions or Fixed manual decision apply clinical edits. Tests so far show no changes and explicit manual metadata.
A quote ending in numeric token 60 is accepted inside source 600; actual omission pass retains altered 60 fact with no quote/operator warning.
